product.description: Modernize your living or office space with a beautiful minimalist TV stand. The low profile architecture reduces the amount of space required to mount your TV. The slim panel provides space to run cables while remaining unnoticed. The steel base structure secures TVs between 37" ~ 70" and weighing up to 88 pounds. Customize the stand according to your needs with its tilting ability, adjustable shelf placement, and adjustable height level.         *The minimum and maximum display sizes are only approximations.
